item.title: Opening Weekend: Independence Blue Cross RiverRink Winterfest
item.description:
Nov 27 11:00 am – Nov 29 11:00 pm

Join us on the Delaware River Waterfront for Opening Weekend at Independence Blue Cross RiverRink Winterfest, November 27–29! Kick off the holiday season with ice skating, festive food and drinks, games, rides, and more before wrapping up the weekend with the Holiday Tree Lighting Powered by PECO.


Winterfest is free to enter and open to the public. You can reserve ice skating and skate rentals in advance, while food, drinks, games, and rides are pay-as-you-go.

 
Opening Weekend Hours
  • Friday: 11 am-1 am (skating ends at 12:30 am)
  • Saturday: 11 am-1 am
  • Sunday: 11 am-11 pm

Plan Your Visit

While you’re here, enjoy ice skating, seasonal eats and drinks, cabins, fire pits, and the Rinkside Lounge. 

What to Know Before You Go
Parking on-site will be limited due to construction on the I-95 CAP. However, many great ways to access the Waterfront include walking and biking along the Delaware River Trail, rideshare, and public transit. item.title: Holiday Tree Lighting Powered by PECO featuring Zinadelphia
item.description:
Nov 29 5:00 pm – Nov 29 8:00 pm

Join us for the Annual Holiday Tree Lighting Powered by PECO featuring Zinadelphia on Sunday, November 29, 2026, at Independence Blue Cross RiverRink Winterfest beginning at 5 pm: Rain or Shine. 
 

Skate admission is $5, and skate rental is $12. Skating sessions sell fast. Book Today!
 

The holidays are shining bright on the Philly Waterfront! Gather your crew for the annual Holiday Tree Lighting powered by PECO on Sunday, November 29, featuring festive performances, live music, and plenty of holiday cheer.

The free celebration kicks off at 5 p.m., with Jay the Gentleman as your host and performances by Emerald Blue, a capella group from Girard Academic Music Program, Philly ska band Catbite, and hometown favorite Zinadelphia, fresh off her European tour. Watch the waterfront light up at 6:55 p.m., followed by a special performance from Zinadelphia.

Schedule:
5 pm: Doors Open
5:30 pm: Emerald Blue
6 pm: Catbite
6:55 pm: Tree Lighting
7 pm: Zinadelphia
 

It's a Philly holiday tradition you won't want to miss!

item.title: New Year’s Eve Fireworks on the Waterfront
item.description:
Dec 31 6:00 pm – Dec 31 12:30 am

As the grand finale of Philadelphia’s holiday season, ring in 2026 with the brightest fireworks show in the area. Enjoy the vibrant show set to an exhilarating soundtrack for an unforgettable New Year's start.


 Enjoy two shows: 6 pm and midnight.

The New Year's Eve Fireworks on the Waterfront can be viewed for free along the Waterfront at Race Street Pier, Penn's Landing, Spruce Street Harbor Park, Pier 68, and Washington Avenue Pier, as well as the Moshulu, Keating's Rope & Anchor, the Spirit of Philadelphia, Independence Seaport Museum, Fringe Arts, Dave & Busters, and Rivers Casino.

Tune into KYW Newsradio 1060 AM or 103.9 FM to hear the fireworks soundtracks timed with both shows, 6 pm and midnight, from home.
